system_prompt: You are a helpful and honest assistant. Please, respond concisely and truthfully.
primary: H1 coverage(CAREFUL) > coverage(NORMAL); H2 coverage(CAREFUL) > coverage(PLACEBO)
note: NORMAL is the V5 FULL prompt byte-identical; PLACEBO and CAREFUL append one sentence each. Same substrate, scorer and budget as V5/V7/V8.
